Our Story
The Gap We Fill

Many children face impossible circumstances.
We provide hope and stability.

Thousands of children in Zambia lack safe homes, proper nutrition, education and emotional support. Found and Loved Safe Home bridges this critical gap by providing comprehensive care, professional guidance and most importantly, unconditional love for children in need.

With a primary focus on children whose parents are currently in correctional care, we provide a safe, nurturing environment where they are supported and cared for until family reunification or placement with relatives is possible.

The Calling

Protecting the Vulnerable

Children impacted by parental incarceration are among the most vulnerable in society and require compassionate, responsible care during periods of family separation.

Our Stewardship

Responsible Temporary Care

Through a certified home in Chunga and access to a nearby school, we provide structured care, moral guidance, and education while supporting pathways toward family reunification.

The Vision

Restored Families and Futures

Children are nurtured in a safe environment that promotes dignity, discipline, and learning, preparing them for reintegration into their families and communities.

Make a Real Difference

Our certified residential home in Chunga currently supports 30+ children who are temporarily separated from their parents due to incarceration. Operating under the approval of relevant authorities, we provide structured care, education, and supervision while prioritising family tracing and safe reunification.
